entries.description: An intentional community on 30 acres in central Maine, chemically free and focused on self-sufficiency, farming, and celebration. They welcome lesbians, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: GATHERING GROUND c/o Linda & Carol, RFD 2, Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172 (End of #10 Rd). We are two (sometimes more) lesbians living on 30 acres surrounded by hundreds of other acres of forest in central Maine. We are chemical free. We share space with Carol's 11-year-old daughter, 3 horses, 10 chickens, 3 ducks, 6 cats and 1 dog. We grow much of our own food. Lesbians are welcome to camp on our land whenever and for as long as they like. They must be self-sufficient and carry all trash out and leave camping space as they found it. We have full moon celebrations on Sat evening closest to full moon every month - all lesbians welcome to share/join us. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 nonlesbian, 30 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, slowly clearing farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because two lesbians live and work on the land together. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from 'We are two... lesbians living on 30 acres' and 'all lesbians welcome', Girl children from 'We welcome: girl children', and Non-lesbian women from 'We welcome: ... nonlesbian women'. Focuses: Spirituality/ritual from 'full moon celebrations', Farming/self-sufficiency from 'grow much of our own food' and 'slowly clearing farmland', Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'chemical free'. Land location inferred from 'End of #10 Rd.' and 'in central Maine'.

entries.description: A private homestead on 10 acres in Central Maine, focusing on homesteading and self-sufficiency. It welcomes new members/residents, girl children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: CHRIS OF COVENTREE PO Box 16, Troy, ME 04987. A sanctuary for women, plants, animals. I started homesteading on ten acre piece of land tucked away in the woods of Central Maine summer of '81. Doe goats, cats, a dog and sometimes other lesbians have shared this homeland with me. I carry my water, plant and preserve the food I grow in my garden and the cheese I make, heat with firewood I mostly cut myself, build with scrap lumber. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (maybe). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 10 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned/hosted by one person ('I started homesteading...', 'I carry my water'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from 'other lesbians have shared' and '1 lesbian', Girl children from 'girl children', and Non-lesbian women from 'nonlesbian women'. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency from 'homesteading', 'plant and preserve the food I grow', and 'self'. Land location inferred from 'woods of Central Maine'.

entries.description: Private land on 30 acres in upstate New York, offering a quiet space for visitors and new members. It welcomes lesbians, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 10.
entries.raw_text: DEER SONG c/o Maggie Laird, RD Box 99, Stamford, NY 12167 (607)652-5057(weekends only). Located between Albany and Binghamton, NY on Steiber Rd. Lesbian couples have stayed here and love the peaceful quiet. 30 miles to a lesbian support group. For now, my two college age sons are part-time dwellers, also dogs and cats. One spare bedroom so Winter is not best for staying. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children (maybe), boy children under 10 to visit, dogs on leash. Please, no hard drugs, guns or heavy drinking. Bring your own groceries. Donations appreciated but not necessary. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 2 nonlesbians, 30 acres, old house, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping space with stream, lots of woods, possible farmland, woman living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is hosted by Maggie Laird ('my two college age sons'). entries.description: A separatist farm and herbal center on 50 acres in New York, offering herbal medicine and healing workshops. It welcomes lesbians, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: LAUGHING ROCK FARM/WISE WOMAN CENTER c/o Susun Weed, 3136 Fishcreek, Saugerties, NY 12477 (near Woodstock). Laughing Rock Farm is safe space for womyn. Maintained as separatist land for 8 years (since '78), Laughing Rock (formerly Rowdybush) is a working homestead with goats, ducks, geese, chickens, cats, fruit, veg and herb gardens, lots of private (clothes off) playing and swimming places, solar greenhouse, and a trillion tons of rock. It is our belief that all womyn (lesbians or not) need separatist space for healing; we offer it, on short-term basis. The Wise Woman Center, offers herbal medicine and spirit healing workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it explicitly offers space 'on short-term basis' and runs workshops/apprenticeships as the Wise Woman Center. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from 'lesbians', Non-lesbian women from 'nonlesbian women', and Girl children from 'girl children'. Focuses: Lesbian separatism from 'Maintained as separatist land', Spirituality/ritual from 'spirit healing workshops', Farming/self-sufficiency from 'working homestead' and 'gardens', Workshops/education from 'workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships', and Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'solar greenhouse'. entries.community_name: SENECA WOMEN'S ENCAMPMENT FOR A FUTURE OF PEACE & JUSTICE
entries.description: A permanent peace encampment and feminist community outside the Seneca Army Depot on 53 acres in New York. It welcomes lesbians, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: SENECA WOMEN'S ENCAMPMENT FOR A FUTURE OF PEACE & JUSTICE 5440 Rt 96, Romulus, NY 14541 (607)869-5825. We are a permanent vigil for peace and justice outside the Seneca Army Depot, the largest nuclear weapons storage site in the world. We are an open, constantly changing, feminist community struggling to overcome oppression and militarism both outside our community and within it. We welcome all women who respect our commitment to non-violence and consensus process for short and long-term stays. Work is done collectively, and all meals are communal and vegetarian. All permanent structures are wheelchair accessible, and there are chem-free spaces on the land. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: many lesbians and nonlesbians, 53 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it describes itself as a 'feminist community' with collective work and communal living. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from 'many lesbians', Non-lesbian women from 'nonlesbian women', Girl children and Boy children from 'girl & boy children'. Land location matches mailing address outside Seneca Army Depot.

entries.description: An intentional community on 35 acres in Maryland, focusing on organic gardening and eco-friendly living. It welcomes new members/residents, lesbians, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE COMMUNITY 2130 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-0280 (35 miles from Baltimore). We are presently 4 lesbians, down from 7 over the summer. We are in big transitions, and are hoping to focus our energies this winter to achieve some concrete goals. Right now it feels like everything is up in the air. Miscommunication is a common theme in our lives and we're struggling for ways to live harmoniously as a group instead of as separate individuals "tolerating" each other. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We're not into drugs. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 35 acres, 5 buildings, conference center facilities, solar greenhouse, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods (25 acres), limited farmland, a lot of gardens - 20 years organic, friendly neighbors, women working the land, an inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it is an established residential community. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from '4 lesbians', Non-lesbian women from 'nonlesbian women', Girl children from 'girl children'. Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly from '20 years organic' and 'solar greenhouse'. Land location matches mailing address.

entries.description: An intentional community on 20 acres in West Virginia, featuring a passive-solar home and hosting women-only concerts. It welcomes non-lesbian women and males.
entries.raw_text: GREENSTALK c/o Nan or Ruth, South Morgan Dr, Box 65, Berkeley Springs, WV 25411 (304)258-5079 (Unger, WV). In 1982, construction of an owner-built, passive-solar home began and is nearing completion. We're musicians and sponsor women-only concerts every June and Sept as Rural Women's Productions. We run a consulting and woodworking business. We welcome: nonlesbian women, males. No drugs, moderate alcohol, smoking restrictions, bring food to share. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, 1 house, 1 permanent structure, plumbing/electricity, unlimited camping space, woods, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because two women built and live on the land together as a household/community. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from '2 lesbians', Non-lesbian women from 'nonlesbian women', Gay men and Non-gay men from 'males'. Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'passive-solar home'. Land location from 'Unger, WV'.

entries.description: Land in rural North Carolina seeking women to build houses and live on the property. It welcomes women/lesbians.
entries.raw_text: HERLAND c/o Duffy Z Baum, PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340 (Located in rural Pittsboro, NC). The property is a mixture of hardwoods and pines with 3 fields and one finished house on 50 acres. I have interested in having other women build houses and live on the land. I am also open to selling 5-10 acres. There is a large, active lesbian political community about 35 miles away in Durham. Herland is about 35 miles from Raleigh and 20 miles from Chapel Hill. Unemployment in this area
